summary: Brown-Forman Corp filed an 8-K reporting completion of a $500 million underwritten debt offering of 5.375% Notes due 2031, priced under a September 17, 2026 underwriting agreement led by Barclays, BofA Securities, Citigroup, J.P. Morgan and U.S. Bancorp Investments. Interest pays semi-annually each April 15 and October 15 beginning April 15, 2027, with maturity October 15, 2031, issued under the company's existing 2007 indenture as supplemented. Net proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, potentially including dividends, buybacks, debt repayment and pension funding. This is a routine investment-grade financing, not a special situation; watch leverage and any repurchase deployment.
